title: 第3章 买院子-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》
content:
第(1/3)页

    儿媳妇改嫁？

    一笔勾销？

    “当真？”

    李虎话音落下，便见赵贵眼前一亮，开口道。

    长子死了。

    儿媳还有何用处？

    若是拿出去抵债，最好不过啊！

    “我不改嫁，我不嫁给李虎。”满身湿润，楚楚可怜的王乃香急忙拒绝道。

    村子里人说。

    李虎有脏病，若是嫁给了他，岂不是要传染给自己？

    下半辈子还不得毁了。

    更何况，这李虎长相丑陋，而且凶得很，半夜都得被吓醒。

    “你说不嫁就不嫁？”

    “我们老赵家把你娶来，可是没少花彩礼，今日我们老赵家遇到事了，你不上谁上？”

    “你嫁到我们家了，就得听婆家的话，我大儿子走了，那你就得听我这个老公爹的，让你嫁，你就得嫁。”

    赵贵怒声训斥道。

    与自己儿子的手相比，儿媳王乃香就算个屁！

    “今日你不嫁过去，我家强子的手可就要被砍断了。”

    “他一个男人，若是成了残疾。”

    “下半辈子可怎么办？”

    “你可不能这么自私啊！”赵贵家的婆娘焦急道。

    李虎见这老两口如此态度，心中顿时一乐。

    嘿。

    自己可是馋王乃香身子许久了，那真是日所思，夜所想啊……！

    想着晚上搂着这小寡妇香喷喷的身子入睡。

    这辈子就没白活。

    王乃香一个姑娘，哪里经历过这些，顿时有些慌乱起来。

    不知所措，那一双水灵灵，楚楚可怜的眼神，求助势的朝着李青山望了过去。

    “现在是新社会，婚姻自由，就算是父母之命媒妁之言，那也是王乃香娘家说了算，和你们婆家有什么关系？”

    李青山见赵贵一家子竟然用道德压人，哼一声站了出来道。

    “她是我们赵家花了彩礼娶回来的。”

    “自然是我们婆家说了算。”

    赵贵开口争辩道。

    “你给的谁彩礼问谁要去，再说了，乃香嫂子嫁过来是当老婆的，不是当寡妇的，你那短命的儿子死了，白白让人家一个黄花闺女守了三年寡。”

    “这是你们老赵家欠乃香嫂子的。”

    “话说回来。”

    “宣传的干事天天喊婚姻自由，你们这是要当落后分子，要被立典型的。”

    李青山怒声训斥之下，赵贵老两口和李虎顿时沉默了。

    他们不怕李青山。

    但是，怕政府的矫正啊！

    “你们若是逼我嫁给李虎，我就死。”

    就在这时。

    王乃香不知道从哪里翻出了剪刀，抵在自己白皙的脖颈之上，因为太过于锋利，脖颈处甚至渗出了丝丝鲜血。

    这是气急之下，动了真格了。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Daughter-in-law remarries?

​Write it off?

"Seriously?"

After Li Hu finished speaking, Zhao Gui's eyes lit up and he spoke.

The eldest son is dead.

What else is the use of a daughter-in-law?

It would be best if you take it out to pay off debts!

“I won’t remarry, I won’t marry Li Hu.” The wet and pitiful Wang Naixiang hurriedly refused.

People in the village said.

Li Hu has a heart disease. If he marries him, won’t he infect himself?

The rest of your life must not be ruined.

What's more, this Li Hu is ugly and fierce, and he has to be frightened awake in the middle of the night.

"You said you won't marry if you don't want to marry?"

"Our old Zhao family married you, but we spent a lot of money as gifts. Today our old Zhao family is in trouble. If you don't marry me, who will?"

"When you marry into our family, you have to listen to your husband's family. My eldest son is gone, then you have to listen to my husband and father. If you are asked to marry, you have to marry."

Zhao Gui scolded angrily.

Compared with her son’s hands, her daughter-in-law Wang Naixiang is nothing!

"If you don't get married today, my strong son's hand will be cut off."

"He is a man, if he becomes disabled."

"What will I do for the rest of my life?"

"You can't be so selfish!" Zhao Gui's mother-in-law said anxiously.

Seeing the attitude of the old couple, Li Hu suddenly felt happy.

    Hey.

I have been coveting Wang Naixiang’s body for a long time. That’s what I think about every day and every night...!

Thinking about sleeping with my arms around this little widow’s fragrant body at night.

This life will not be in vain.

Wang Naixiang, a girl who had never experienced anything like this before, suddenly became a little panicked.

At a loss, those pair of watery, pitiful eyes looked towards Li Qingshan for help.

"Now is a new society, with freedom of marriage. Even if your parents order a matchmaker, it is Wang Naixiang's mother's family who has the final say. What does it have to do with your husband's family?"

When Li Qingshan saw that Zhao Gui’s family was using morality to suppress others, he stood up with a snort and said.

"She was brought back by our Zhao family with a betrothal gift."

“Of course our husband’s family has the final say.”

Zhao Gui argued.

"It's up to you to ask whoever you gave as a bride price. Besides, sister-in-law Naixiang was married to be a wife, not a widow. Your short-lived son died, leaving a young girl to remain a widow for three years."

"This is what your old Zhao family owes to Sister-in-law Naixiang."

"Having said that."

“Propaganda officials are shouting about freedom of marriage every day, but you are trying to be regarded as backward elements and be set up as role models.”

Under Li Qingshan’s angry scolding, Mr. Zhao Gui and Li Hu suddenly fell silent.

They are not afraid of Li Qingshan.

But, I’m afraid of the government’s correction!

"If you force me to marry Li Hu, I will die."

At this moment.

Wang Naixiang took out the scissors from somewhere and put them against her fair neck. Because they were too sharp, a trace of blood even oozed from her neck.

This is when I got angry and got serious.
